title: Tattoos Doubled, Women Lead, And Most Owners Have Multiple
hook: Tattoos became mainstream, and most owners did not stop at one.
closing: Tattoos moved from rebellion to a mainstream habit that often becomes a collection.
question: How many tattoos do you have?

segments.say: Tattoos doubled, reaching 32 percent of American adults.
Women lead at 37 percent, pushing tattoos even further into the mainstream.
Twenty-two percent of adults have multiple tattoos, more than double the share with exactly one.
